{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the case of 'severe' in the data
print('Unique severity values (lowercase):', df['severity'].str.lower().unique())

# Filter for patients with severe disease (using lowercase for consistency)
severe_df = df[df['severity'].str.lower() == 'severe']

# Check number of patients with severe disease
print('Number of patients with severe disease:', len(severe_df))

# Check for sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline for severe patients
sentinel_count = (severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print('Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline for severe patients:', sentinel_count)

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
severe_clean = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check number of valid baseline values
print('Number of valid baseline values for severe patients:', len(severe_clean))

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline_severe = severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print('Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) for severe patients:', mean_baseline_severe)"}
